title: Black Power
writer: Alfredo B. Crevenna, Alfonso Morones A., Roberto Rodríguez
actors: Héctor Suárez, Lila Morillo, Mil Máscaras
plot: A black dockworker Pedro getting mixed up with a gang of arms smugglers and falsely imprisoned on a charge of murder. He is finally released and Mr. Mil convinces him to become a luchador/wrestler under the name of "Black Power".
